name: freight-reconciliation
description: Payer-side freight reconciliation expert: import carrier bills and trip ledgers into a deterministic local core (SQLite, no cloud), re-calculate against contracted rates, and produce evidence-linked difference lists for human review. Never approves payments, never sends anything; final confirmations route through a local admin page. MCP server pinned via uvx to the immutable commit harrylabsj/freight-reconciliation@e8cd259c43f3607250eda4074ce3e8ab0e6e1bf5 (release v0.4.1).
